gate_inputs: Predicted bilateral contacts, actual contact-count history and trusted TaskSpec only; no oracle/fault/policy-instruction answers

test_design.pairing: Same initialization content, per-scenario policy/env reset+seed, actual instruction and native contract for B0/G; report any divergence before effects

statistics.confidence_intervals: Paired bootstrap of initialization clusters, stratified by task; preserve both conditions and both systems within cluster
statistics.missing_or_partial: All attempts remain in planned denominator; report unknown/censored events and best/worst-case bounds, never silently label incomplete as safe
statistics.candidate_UAR: First-major-event-or-earlier fixed B0 prefixes only; UAR=N/A when no first-major-event denominator

authorization_boundary: R004 permits DEV and conditional CALIB only. GPT must issue one R2 decision bound to final code/config/evidence before TEST. Current entry points reject TEST. No executor approval, automatic merge, training, WBC or real robot.
